arguments.name: From possible explanation to actual explanation of the maximal contingent fact
premises: Admissible world-complete BCCFs, maximality, bivalence and compossibility.
W-PSR: every proposition true at any possible world can obtain with an explanation.
bridge_principles: A world containing the complete actual BCCF must be the actual world.
arguments.conclusion: Conditionally, the actual BCCF has an actual explanation.
arguments.strongest_objection: Oppy: universal W-PSR entails the strong principle under explanatory assumptions; weaker counterpart intuitions do not warrant the world-complete premise, and informed rational dissent can remain.
arguments.strongest_reply: The actual2002 reply grants the deduction while defending epistemic plausibility, incomplete deductive understanding, and a preference for explanation over brute facts; it offers a conditional restricted BCCF* fallback (pp90–97).
unresolved_issues: W-PSR warrant and changed contingent-proposition restriction
Admissibility of totality and explanatory distribution
External cardinality proof and later objections uninspected

arguments.name: From total explanation to a necessary free agent and its attributes
premises: An actual totality explanation is available under A-P2T10-001.
Personal/scientific explanation exhausts the intelligible options.
Contingent explanantia cannot explain themselves, while a necessary being’s libertarian action can terminate explanation.
Genuine contingency rules out necessitating creative action.
bridge_principles: Treat necessary existence and contingent free action separately.
Add teleological evidence and further theodicy for power, intelligence and goodness.
arguments.conclusion: Conditionally, a necessary free agent creates the actual universe; rich qualities require further arguments.
arguments.strongest_objection: The defender’s reported Quinn alternative is an impersonal indeterministic necessary source; the strongest project question is why libertarian self-explanation is sufficient when impersonal indeterminism is not, given context-sensitive explanatory fullness.
arguments.strongest_reply: Gale and Pruss argue that only free action can be an indeterministic self-explainer, appeal to cosmic order, and offer a generic necessary powerful cause fallback (p472).
unresolved_issues: Explanatory exhaustiveness and privileged stopping point
Teleology, actual benevolence, unity and omni-properties
Reported correspondence is not separately inspected Quinn source

arguments.name: Weak-to-strong PSR and informed rejection
premises: Explanation is veridical and dissective under the stated modal logic.
W-PSR applies to an obtaining conjunction that says a fact obtains and is unexplained.
Some non-theists have independently rational grounds that conflict with the conclusion.
bridge_principles: Explaining the conjunction produces the conditional reductio.
Logical entailment does not settle which belief should be revised; initial assent may have been uninformed.
arguments.conclusion: The advertised weakness advantage is not established by those premises; rational rejection can remain.
arguments.strongest_objection: The2002 reply grants entailment but argues that incomplete deductive knowledge can coexist with adequate understanding, that evil does not defeat every necessary creator, and that W-PSR better coheres with inquiry (pp90–97).
arguments.strongest_reply: Oppy conditions the objection on independent rational grounds and distinguishes modal intuition about a duplicate from the universal world-complete premise; he does not prove all non-theists possess the needed grounds.
unresolved_issues: No independent validation of comparative epistemic premise warrant
Materialism plausibility ranking explicitly unargued in reply
Later Guigon and distribution/totality challenges not inspected

arguments.name: Lennox’s compatibility and positive order argument
arguments.position: Selected Lennox relevance, not a direct reply to Gale–Pruss or Oppy
premises: Mechanism and agent can explain different aspects of an artifact.
The universe exhibits intelligibility and sophisticated lawlike order.
Such order and rational capacities are asserted to fit creative intelligence.
bridge_principles: Compatibility removes one alleged incompatibility; it does not by itself favor agency.
Comparative support needs defensible expectations for personal and impersonal alternatives.
arguments.conclusion: The essay supplies a compatible creator interpretation and a further positive abductive claim; its comparative strength remains unresolved.
arguments.strongest_objection: Artifact analogy and asserted creator preferences do not independently establish a cosmic designer or show natural cognition unreliable.
arguments.strongest_reply: Lennox explicitly offers positive intelligibility and sophistication reasons, not only compatibility; excluding all non-scientific explanation would itself need argument.
unresolved_issues: History of science and miracle assertions uncorroborated
Shared order assumptions with the PSR argument’s attribute stage
